0022600204.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (5-5, 2nd in the Central, 1.5 games back, 7th in the East) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-7, 4th in the Southeast, 3.5 games back, 10th in the East) for the Cavaliers' 11th game of the season, with Cleveland on a one-game losing streak and Charlotte on six straight defeats. Cleveland is 1-3 on the road, Charlotte is 2-4 at home, and the Cavaliers are without Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain), Sam Merrill (out, elbow) and Jarrett Allen (day-to-day, knee, game-time decision), while the Hornets are missing Brandon Miller (out, groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (out, hamstring strain), Grant Williams (out, hamstring), Kon Knueppel (out, hamstring strain) and Moussa Diabate (day-to-day, quadriceps, game-time decision). The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Cavaliers won the season series 3-1, including a 118-113 win in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
